messages:
Nora L: FYI we closed the NDA with Skyline HPC this morning. They're offering a three-week early access window in June for their new A100-class blades. NDA link (internal): https://redwood-internal/partnerships/skyline/nda
Diego M: Nice! Do we have specifics on node topo and NVLink fabric? Need to pick batch targets and multi-GPU strategy.
Nora L: Skyline said: 8xA100 per chassis, NVLink across pairs, Mellanox HDR interconnect. They'll provide a jumpbox and a pre-configured conda environment. Access target: Jun 7-27.
Partner Hub Bot: Created partner workspace: /partnerships/skyline-preview; added default checklist template.
Ravi S.: For benching, propose run matrix: Llama2-70B (fp16), Mistral-7B (int8), and a customer-like RAG scenario. Metrics: p50/p95 latency, tokens/s, GPU utilization, mem peak, cold-start load.
Diego M: Agree. Also include multi-GPU sharding (tensor/pipeline) tests and NCCL tuning flags. I can draft run scripts.
Lina K: Heads-up: Skyline asked whether we'd be open to a coordinated press blurb if numbers look good. We should clear joint messaging with legal & PR.
Nora L: Yes. First step is to validate from a reliability/correctness POV, then discuss joint announcement. Legal wants to review any bench artifacts first.
Ravi S.: Quick fallback plan: if int8 ops miscompile, we'll run int8 baseline on Redwood Dedicated and mark it as "compatibility-bypass" in results.
Diego M: Draft run example for perf harness: ```bash
# run perf (example)
python -m rbench.run \ 
  --model {model} \ 
  --dtype {dtype} \ 
  --shard_strategy {tensor|pipeline|data} \ 
  --batch_sizes 1,2,4,8 \ 
  --seq 2048 \ 
  --measure p50,p95,tokens_per_sec,gpu_mem
```
Diego M: We'll include reproducibility keys: image tag, git commit, model sha256.
Lina K: I'll coordinate with PR to draft contingency language for the joint blurb and get legal to pre-approve allowed screenshots and metrics disclosure.
Partner Hub Bot: New task: "Skyline preview bench plan" assigned to Diego M, due 2026-06-01
Nora L: Timeline: draft bench plan by Jun 1, request access creds by Jun 5, run Jun 7-27, internal results review Jun 30, PR decision in first week of July.
Ravi S.: I'll prep a small dockerfile and a benchmark-launch wrapper that logs environment and NCCL settings.
Diego M: Please also request BIOS/firmware versions from Skyline. Sometimes that changes perf more than drivers.
Nora L: Good call. I'll ask Skyline to include firmware, driver, and a brief runbook for jumpbox auth.
Lina K: And I'll get the PR brief ready (draft w/ placeholders). If we decide to announce, we'll align messaging on perf + engineering collaboration angle.
Nora L: Great work. Post follow-ups in the partner workspace; tagging this resolved for now :white_check_mark:
